pages.text:
Contoso Holdings
Board Pack – Group Financial Summary, quarter ended 31 March 2026
Status: Approved board pack (unaudited) Prepared: 05 May 2026 Currency: AED
1. Financial summary by entity
AED '000 Revenue Operating expenses Net profit
Contoso Retail LLC 12,840 2,995 1,307
Contoso Logistics LLC 8,720 1,402 896
Contoso Properties LLC 5,240 3,215 604
Group total 26,800 7,613 2,807
All figures in AED thousands, rounded.
2. Highlights
Group revenue for the first quarter was ahead of budget, led by Contoso Retail. Contoso Logistics delivered steady
volumes. Contoso Properties reported a temporary cash shortfall at quarter end, which management expects to
reverse in April.
3. Matters for the Board
The Board is asked to note the first-quarter results and the revised timing of two new retail outlets, now expected to
open in May 2026.
